snippet.title: The Mailroom - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hell wants you! To come work for us at the Mailroom. 

Play The Mailroom now on STEAM:
🔗 https://themailroom.withvendetta.com/playnow

It’s time to clock in and sell your soul to literal corporate hell. Take on your first day in the underworld, meet your strange coworkers, and discover whether you have what it takes to get through a week without losing your sanity. 

Hell’s got some…strange…departments. And it’s up to you to keep them running and the mail ever-flowing. 

So what are you waiting for? Your first day starts…now. 

Take our Personality Quiz for a chance to win a free frog: 
🔗https://www.themailroom.withvendetta.com/giveaway

Join the Crowfriend Discord
🔗 https://discord.gg/pxPXgBXcq 

Follow the Mailroom: 
Twitter/X: https://x.com/TheMailroomGame 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/themailroom.bsky.social 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/themailroomgame/ 
TikTok:  https://www.tiktok.com/@the.mailroom 
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@withvendettagames 

About The Mailroom: 
Survive the horrors of hell’s deadest-end job: a human mail clerk. Process occult specimens, sort infernal mail, repair cursed machinery, and survive your shift in a cozy horror workplace simulator.

About Vendetta
Indie publisher and go-to-market partner built for indie studios run by rebels, weirdos and troublemakers. F*ck the norms.
